"""Validation semantics."""
import json, subprocess, sys

PY = [sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '/workspace/submission/main.py']
FAILURES = []


def run(request):
    data = request if isinstance(request, (bytes, str)) else json.dumps(request)
    if isinstance(data, str):
        data = data.encode()
    proc = subprocess.run(PY, input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=180)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, (proc.returncode, proc.stderr.decode()[:3000])
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())


def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILURES.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got ", json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True)[:1500])
        print("  want", json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)[:1500])
    else:
        print("pass", name)


def topo():
    return {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 100},
                      {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 100}],
            "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 100}],
            "external_nodes": ["A", "B"]}


def settings(**kw):
    base = {"trials": 4, "epsilon": 0, "seed": 11, "cutoff": [0, 1], "bias": 0,
            "tau": 0, "gamma": [1, 1], "cache_slots": 2}
    base.update(kw)
    return base


def plan():
    return {"A": {"B": [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 1000}]},
            "B": {"A": [{"path": ["B", "A"], "weight": 1000}]}}


def events_result(events, **kw):
    out = run({"streams": [{"topology": topo(), "settings": settings(**kw), "events": events}]})
    return out["streams"][0]["events"]


PATCH = {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 10], [1, 0, 3]], "counters": {
    "low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 10}, "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 10},
    "low_B_egress_to_A": {"perturbed": 3}, "low_A_ingress_from_B": {"perturbed": 3},
    "low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 10}, "low_A_termination": {"perturbed": 3},
    "low_B_origination": {"perturbed": 3}, "low_B_termination": {"perturbed": 10}}}

# with routes: internal and external flows are expected -> 8 checks
out = events_result([PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()},
                     {"op": "repair", "id": "r"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}])
check("validate/with routes", out[3], {"op": "validate", "id": "r", "checked": 8, "passed": 8,
                                       "consistent": True, "failed": []})

# without routes: only the external marginals are expected -> 4 checks
out = events_result([PATCH, {"op": "repair", "id": "r"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}])
check("validate/null paths", out[2], {"op": "validate", "id": "r", "checked": 4, "passed": 4,
                                      "consistent": True, "failed": []})

# the cutoff removes cells: the maximum confidence is 5
out = events_result([PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()},
                     {"op": "repair", "id": "r"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}], cutoff=[5, 1])
check("validate/cutoff filters all", out[3], {"op": "validate", "id": "r", "checked": 0, "passed": 0,
                                              "consistent": None, "failed": []})

# cutoff in the middle: internal flows carry confidence 5, external flows 3
out = events_result([PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()},
                     {"op": "repair", "id": "r"}, {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}], cutoff=[4, 1])
check("validate/cutoff partial", out[3], {"op": "validate", "id": "r", "checked": 4, "passed": 4,
                                          "consistent": True, "failed": []})

# a changed demand invalidates the prediction: the frozen repair is checked
# against the current demands
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "r"},
          {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 40]], "counters": {}},
          {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}]
out = events_result(events)
check("validate/current demands", out[4]["checked"], 8)
check("validate/current demands failed", out[4]["passed"] < 8, True)
check("validate/current demands failed keys", out[4]["failed"], sorted(out[4]["failed"]))

# the failed list is ascending ASCII
check("validate/failed order", out[4]["failed"], sorted(out[4]["failed"]))

# gamma decides consistency
out = events_result(events, gamma=[1, 1])
check("validate/gamma strict", out[4]["consistent"], False)
out = events_result(events, gamma=[0, 1])
check("validate/gamma zero", out[4]["consistent"], True)

# tau and bias change the outcome
out = events_result(events, tau=1000000)
check("validate/tau generous", out[4]["passed"], out[4]["checked"])
out = events_result(events, bias=1000000)
check("validate/bias", out[4]["passed"], out[4]["checked"])

# the frozen snapshot survives later repairs and later state changes
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "r"},
          {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 40]], "counters": {}},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "s"},
          {"op": "validate", "id": "r"},
          {"op": "validate", "id": "s"}]
out = events_result(events)
check("validate/snapshot independent", out[5]["checked"], 8)
check("validate/snapshot independent failed", out[5]["passed"] < 8, True)
check("validate/second snapshot", out[6]["checked"], 8)

# replacing a snapshot id
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "r"},
          {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 40]], "counters": {}},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "r"},
          {"op": "validate", "id": "r"}]
out = events_result(events)
check("validate/snapshot replaced", out[5]["checked"], 8)

# a validate event never refreshes the repair cache
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "validate", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = events_result(events, cache_slots=1)
check("validate/no cache refresh", out[4]["cache_hit"], True)

print("failures:", FAILURES)
sys.exit(1 if FAILURES else 0)
PYEOF
